title: Require an observation law that separates actual correct and wrong-site bonds
statement: For complete available observation O with laws P_C,P_W under correct and stable wrong-site covalent products, every randomized receipt delta(O) in[0,1] has alpha-beta<=TV(P_C,P_W), alpha=E_C delta,beta=E_W delta. For p,w>0,alpha>0 and the specified identical independent accepted-stage law, L-stage conditional purity is[1+(w/p)*(beta/alpha)]^-L. Target F in(0,1] requires beta/alpha<=(p/w)*(F^(-1/L)-1). Identical observation laws forbid discrimination by downstream logic alone.

requires: Correct and wrong SITE/sequence classes and their actual complete observation laws, including all repeated/adaptive data used by the controller.
For purity, positive p,w,alpha and identical independent accepted-stage behavior or a justified conditional product model.

assumptions: No amount of processing a fixed observation can supply omitted chemical information; additional chemistry-sensitive interventions change the interface.
The false class here is stable wrong covalent product, not a freely departing unjoined donor. Do not substitute a wash decay for beta.
costs: Acquire site/sequence-sensitive information and account for accepted fraction, culling and original-root yield separately.
contract.units: TV,alpha,beta,F,p,w dimensionless; purity is conditional on admitted products, not starting-root survival.
contract.obstruction: Establish the actual wrong-site observation separation before treating a DNA receipt as a certificate of chemical identity.

body: Variational TV bounds every bounded randomized acceptance function. Bayes odds among admitted products are w*beta/(p*alpha), yielding the conditional purity formula and required ratio. A common downstream stochastic transformation cannot create distinguishability absent from the full available observation. Repeated readings are covered only when O denotes their complete joint record: equal one-read marginals alone need not imply equal joint laws. Covalent continuity may separate a joined product from an unjoined donor while failing to distinguish two stable rooted bond sites. This statement neither asserts all actual PNA products are observationally identical nor supplies a molecular assay. A source-reported hypothetical TV target is not an acquired measurement.
